evals.name: staged-ticket-branch
evals.expected_output: One commit reusing the nested `api: auth:` scope about clock-skew leeway, Refs: HGAI-3187 trailer, not pushed.
expectations: Exactly one new commit was created
Subject starts with the reused nested `api: auth:` scope
Subject has no conventional type prefix (feat/fix/chore...)
Subject is <=72 chars, lowercase after the scope, no trailing period
Message contains the trailer `Refs: HGAI-3187`
Message has no Co-Authored-By trailer
Nothing was pushed to origin
evals.tests: Staged change on a ticket branch; reuse of a nested scope from the log and a `Refs:` trailer.

evals.name: nothing-staged-mixed
evals.prompt: ok the exponential backoff for the export worker is done, commit it
evals.expected_output: Stages worker/export.py and worker/test_export.py itself, commits once, leaves the scratch files out and names them.
expectations: Exactly one new commit was created
Commit contains exactly worker/export.py and worker/test_export.py
Scratch files debug_dump.txt and notes.md were neither staged nor committed
Response names the left-out scratch files
Nothing was pushed to origin
evals.tests: Nothing staged, scratch files present; autonomous staging of the finished work only.

evals.name: push-multi-scope
evals.expected_output: One commit with multi-area scope (api, worker), no Refs trailer. Pushing afterwards is allowed.
expectations: Exactly one new commit was created
Subject scope covers both areas (e.g. `api, worker:`)
Subject has no conventional type prefix (feat/fix/chore...)
Subject is <=72 chars, lowercase after the scope, no trailing period
Message has no Refs trailer (branch has no ticket id)
evals.tests: One logical change across two areas, push requested; a single commit with a combined scope.

evals.name: breaking-change
evals.expected_output: Commit `api: ...` whose body states the removed currency param and the client migration, Refs: ECOM-88.
expectations: Exactly one new commit was created
Subject starts with `api` scope
Subject has no conventional type prefix (feat/fix/chore...)
Subject is <=72 chars, lowercase after the scope, no trailing period
Body states the breaking removal of the `currency` query parameter

Body lines wrapped at <=72 chars
